literal: Enduring life all having put to sleep having been gracious night, me except is not companion.
translation: The night has graciously put all living beings to sleep; now it has no companion except me.
modern: உலகத்து உயிர்களை எல்லாம் தூங்கச் செய்துவிட்டுத் தனித்திருக்கும் இந்த இரவுக்கு, இப்போது என்னைத் தவிர வேறு துணை இல்லை.
explanation: The speaker, suffering from the pain of separation, observes the deep stillness of the night. The word 'tuyiṟṟi' means making others sleep, and 'aḷittu' shows the night's kindness in giving rest to all creatures. Since everyone else is asleep, the speaker feels that the night itself is awake and lonely, with no one but her for company. This highlights her own sleeplessness and profound isolation.
